title: Prompt-Based Abstention Fails Under Misleading Context: A Controlled Study of Small Frozen RAG Models
read_scope: Main methods, experimental setup, results, discussion and limitations (§§3–7, PDF pp3–9); selected table values checked in extracted text. Appendices not comprehensively read.
publication_evidence: Conference proceedings metadata in existing catalog; publisher PDF retrieved. Exact day within November and independent formal eligibility adjudication unresolved.
research_question: Do small frozen models abstain when evidence is missing versus fluent but factually misleading?
method: Matched question across Q100 five gold passages; Q50 three gold plus two hard negatives; Q0 hard negatives only; QC one entity-swapped passage plus four hard negatives. P0–P2 prompting; P3 closed-book string-agreement veto; P4 context NLI against closed-book answer.
data_and_controls: 500 NQ and 500 HotpotQA sampled questions; QC-eligible subsets202 and330. Three frozen quantized3.8B–8B models, English extractive QA;64,980 output rows are not unique questions.
metric_definition: HwSA is answer rate in should-abstain conditions, including gold-correct overrides under QC; FAC uses P1-anchored capable set; EM/F1, raw answer rate and AURC are separate.
author_reported_result: Table2 macro over six model×dataset cells: QC answer rate41.6% P1→13.3% P3; Q100 raw answer rate79.3%→33.4%; FAC@Q1000% by P1 construction→49.8%. P4 QC14.0%,Q100 answer54.7%.
limits_and_critical_reading: Controlled answer swaps; QC eligibility biased toward easier factoids; no natural inter-document conflict; small English quantized models; closed-book parametric anchor unreliable. Context support is not world truth.
implication_for_literature: Simple abstention prompting or NLI alone is not a new nor established sufficient solution; evidence sufficiency must be distinguished from source factual reliability.
source_locator: §§3.2–3.5, Fig1, PDF pp3–5; §§4–6, Tables1–3, pp5–8; Limitations pp8–9.

title: Relevance Is Not Sufficient Evidence: Detecting Evidence Gaps Before Generation in RAG
read_scope: Main benchmark construction/evaluation and methods/results/ablations/conclusion (§§3–7, PDF pp3–10); Tables3–6. Appendices not comprehensively read.
publication_evidence: Retrieved manuscript says Preprint. Under review; existing metadata arXiv first submission2026-09-27. No published venue established in this round.
research_question: Can evidence sufficiency be ranked from the question and passages before generating an answer, beyond topical relevance?
method: Three readers: local question-content coverage, extractive span-vs-null evidence, frozen1.5B latent cross-passage reader; training-fold size correction/standardization; fixed equal-weight sum. Paired substitution, deletion, question-swap contrasts and native IIRC.
data_and_controls: 13,600 training records with evaluated family held out for fitted components; six paired evaluation datasets;3,149 BM25-versus-dense retrieval pairs over five datasets. Training records are not all evaluation questions.
metric_definition: Pairwise accuracy ranks sufficient over insufficient context within group; ties0.5. It is not final-answer accuracy, a calibrated probability, or claim-level citation correctness.
author_reported_result: Table4 mean PA0.837 RINSE vs0.746 Self-RAG and0.784 API Sufficient Context; SQuAD2.0 RINSE0.684 vsSelf-RAG0.752. Table5 real-retrieval pairs meanPA0.813 vsAPI0.800. Gate diagnostic reduces insufficient-record answering0.636→0.511 but sufficient-record answering0.861→0.783.
limits_and_critical_reading: Constructed contrasts and incomplete support annotations can leave artifacts; top-five cap for latent reader; span reader poor on invented-event deletion; no Vietnamese museum validation; PA does not establish optimal deployment threshold. Reported timings use A100.
implication_for_literature: Pre-generation sufficiency gate already exists. Need separate sufficiency and citation-support literatures and inspect benchmark shortcuts before any novelty assertion.
source_locator: §3 and Table3, PDF pp3–6; §4 pp6–7; §5 and Tables4–5 pp8–9; §6/Table6 p10.

title: GuidelineGuard: An Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation Framework with Sentence-Level Citation Auditing for Guideline-Grounded Question Answering
read_scope: Publisher HTML methods §§3.1–3.11; results §§4.8–4.12; discussion §§5.1–5.5; limitations §6; Tables3,12,13; Data Availability. Other initial-result subsections not comprehensively reread.
publication_evidence: Computation14(9),210; DOI10.3390/computation14090210 from publisher HTML metadata. Publisher PDF page count not verified; formal eligibility not adjudicated.
research_question: What does a separate claim–sentence auditor change in guideline-grounded QA, including false rejection and coverage?
method: Hybrid BM25+dense/RRF; Planner–Retriever–Clinician; auditor sees only claim and candidate evidence sentence; Entails/Partially/Not gate then LLM synthesis. Expanded no-auditor and auditor arms share observable pre-audit state for200/200 and496/500 cases.
data_and_controls: 73-sentence English clinical corpus; author-authored GG60 expanded by140 deterministic template items toGG200; external PubMedQA held-out500. Original Llama results and successor gpt-oss20b/120b runs must not be pooled.
metric_definition: Operational accuracy counts abstention wrong; selective accuracy conditions on commitment; coverage reported jointly. Gold-ID alignment and citation validity are reference proxies, not human entailment. Original CF is macro case score with empty cases0 and differs across evaluator paths.
author_reported_result: GG200 no-auditor191/200 correct,192 commitments; auditor185/200 correct,186 commitments, rejecting6 correct and0 incorrect. Pub500 no-auditor accuracy.638/coverage.896/selective.712 vsauditor.550/.736/.747.496 paired cases: gate rejects36 incorrect and45 correct commitments.
limits_and_critical_reading: Author-constructed/synthetic in-domain cases; no independent clinician adjudication; MCQ English setting, small corpus; original cross-system citation judges differ; NLI agreement is not human validation; expanded model family differs; raw package not reproduced here.
implication_for_literature: Independent auditor and claim-level verification are prior work; a selective-accuracy gain can coexist with lower total accuracy and unnecessary refusals. Common judge needed for comparable support scores.
source_locator: HTML §§3.4,3.6–3.10; Table3; §§4.8,4.12 and Tables12–13; §6; Data Availability.

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Conflicting Evidence
read_scope: PDF §§3–7 (pp4–10), Table1, Fig3, AppendixD/Table2(p17). Fig3 inspected visually on rendered PDFp9. Other appendices not comprehensively read.
publication_evidence: Retrieved PDF header says Published as a conference paper at COLM2025. Existing catalog still arXiv-only; independent proceedings-record identity/version check pending, not silently reclassified.
research_question: Can RAG preserve multiple legitimate answers while rejecting misinformation and noise under inter-document conflict?
method: RAMDocs extends ambiguity questions with variable1–3 legitimate answers,1–3 supporting documents per answer,0–2 misinformation and0–2 noisy documents. One agent per document, shuffled aggregator, up to3 debate rounds with early stopping.
data_and_controls: RAMDocs500 queries,mean2.20 valid answers and5.53 documents; sampled AmbigDocs1000 and FaithEval inconsistent1000. Llama3.3-70B,Qwen2.5-72B,GPT-4o-mini; Self-RAG baseline has adapted aggregation.
metric_definition: Strict set exact match requires all gold answers and no incorrect answer; ablation also answer-level precision/recall/F1. Not claim-level citation attribution or calibrated abstention quality.
author_reported_result: Table1 Llama prompt vsMADAM: RAMDocs32.60→34.40%,FaithEval27.30→43.10%,AmbigDocs54.20→58.20%. Fig3 RAMDocs with aggregator rounds1/2/3 accuracy37.8/36.8/34.4%, so more rounds not monotonically better. AppendixD mean tokens input3186.45/output1547.18 vsplain822.69/126.25.
limits_and_critical_reading: Synthetic answer swaps and selected/chunked supporting documents; legitimacy/factuality labels assumed from construction; no Vietnamese museum validation or direct cited-claim entailment gold; debate incurs token cost and does not guarantee truth. No distinct main-text Limitations section located.
implication_for_literature: Do not map every apparent conflict to refusal. Entity ambiguity can justify multiple qualified answers; factual contradiction is a different case. Debate and conflict handling already have direct baselines.
source_locator: §3 pp4–5; §4 pp5–6; §5/Table1 pp6–8; §6/Fig3 p9; AppendixD/Table2 p17.
